objective: Persist discussion sessions losslessly across safe exit and resume while classifying every future-discussion request into a reviewable AR mapping.
assumptions: Private raw text remains outside public state
Public records retain bounded summaries and digests
Coordinator owns AR identity and revision
unknowns: Storage adapters may vary while preserving journal semantics
invariants: A save is atomic and revision-bound
Duplicate saves do not erase prior records
Re-ask and unresolved status remain visible
Every future request is classified and mapped or explicitly rejected
acceptance_predicates: Interrupted, stale, duplicate, omitted-request, and unmapped-request fixtures reject

formalization.scope: finite session journal and future-request mapping
